name: Iowa
status_why: Clarity on the Secretary's own domain answered scripts; the kit already reads it.
system: Clarity Elections (Scytl/Civica Clarity ENR) on the Secretary of State's own domain: electionresults.iowa.gov

results_page.label: Iowa Secretary of State: election results

feeds.address: https://electionresults.iowa.gov/IA/elections.json (list: EID, ElectionName, Date) -> /IA/<EID>/current_ver.txt -> /IA/<EID>/<ver>/json/en/summary.json (every contest: C title, CH choices, P parties, V votes, TP/PR counties total/reporting)
feeds.updates: Each new version number on current_ver.txt (Clarity typically every few minutes on election night)
feeds.note: 200 on 2026-10-09 (CloudFront, gzip). 2026 primary EID 126082 version 377216: statewide summary reports by county (TP 99).

feeds.address: /IA/<EID>/<ver>/json/en/electionsettings.json lists 'participatingcounties' as name|eid|version; each county: /IA/<county>/<county EID>/<ver>/json/en/summary.json
Clarity county reports: /IA/<county>/<EID>/<ver>/reports/detailxml.zip (precinct and vote-type detail)
feeds.note: Standard Clarity path, not requested here.

races_in_feed: Statewide, Congress, Legislature, judicial retention, county offices; city and school elections are odd-year (the Nov 4, 2025 City-School election is on the same system).
local: County pages sit inside the same system. Polk (dmcountyelections.iowa.gov), Linn, Scott, Johnson also post their own pages (addresses in state_local_ia.py).
how_counted: County auditors upload their counts through the night.
count_order: Clarity detail XML likely splits Election Day and Absentee; not confirmed live.
vote_types: Likely yes: Clarity detail XML carries VoteType breakdowns (Election Day, Absentee) where counties enter them; Iowa's canvass reports Election Day and Absentee per precinct (ballot/ia_place_votes.py). Not confirmed live.

certify.body: the Iowa State Board of Canvassers
certify.rule: The Secretary of State presents the abstracts no later than 27 days after the election and the board approves the canvass (Iowa Code 50.38).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

scout_plan: Live-readable. Poll elections.json until the 2026 General appears, then poll current_ver.txt every 2 to 5 minutes and fetch summary.json only when the version changes (statewide and Congress), plus each county's summary for county offices and legislative seats; detailxml.zip per county gives precincts and vote types for the count-order predictor. Rehearse on EID 126082 and 124196.
sources: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
